tools.name: customer_orders_create-order
tools.description: Place a real, billable order for a customer, or change an existing subscription. Every lifecycle change in ION is an order on this same endpoint: set each order item's `action` (CREATE or UPDATE) and pass `resourceId` (the vendor subscription ID) for updates, with name/value `attributes` from the product's provisioning template. Documented update attributes: operations=updateSubscription with a new `quantity` (licence count, also during renewal); operations=updateSubscription + renewalSetting (auto_on, cancel_at_renewal, renew_to_est); operations=updateSubscription + statusUpdate (suspended, active, deleted); operations=changeSubscription with a new skuId/planId (upgrade); operations=updateSubscription + friendlyName. Microsoft creates also take domainName and the agreement* attributes. Reserved Instance orders cannot be placed through the API. Sources: https://docs.streamone.cloud/#create-order , https://docs.streamone.cloud/#update-order , https://docs.streamone.cloud/#update-order-license-count , https://docs.streamone.cloud/#update-order-renewal-settings , https://docs.streamone.cloud/#update-order-delete-suspend-reactivate-subscription , https://docs.streamone.cloud/#update-order-upgrade-subscription-from-lower-tier-to-higher-tier , https://docs.streamone.cloud/#update-order-adding-entitlement-and-friendly-name Official spec: CreateOrder. Required: accountId, customerId, orderItems. Optional: displayName, name, referenceId. Returns the new Order.

params.description: Reseller account ID (portal Quick Access > Account Information).

novel_features.description: Export your TD SYNNEX licences as normalized, schema-versioned rows (customer, SKU key, seats, monthly cost and price, renewal) for a PSA or a true-up; tenant and domain columns stay blank because ION subscriptions do not carry them.

novel_features.name: Cross-distributor true-up
novel_features.description: Compare seats per customer and SKU across TD SYNNEX and Pax8, Sherweb or PSA export files mapped into the licence-position columns, with unmatched rows listed instead of guessed.

novel_features.name: Subscription change feed
novel_features.description: List seat, renewal, status, tier and friendly-name changes requested through ION orders in a past window, decoded from the order attributes; failed orders are left out and changes made outside ION are not visible.

novel_features.name: Stuck orders
novel_features.description: Find orders still NEW, IN_PROGRESS, CONFIRMED or ON_HOLD past an age threshold, plus recent errors, with a flag for the ones you can still cancel.

novel_features.name: Customer 360
novel_features.description: One view of a customer from the local store: profile, subscriptions with seats and monthly cost and price, open orders and recent changes, plus the cloud-profiles command for live GDAP/MCA status.
